param.name: cachePool
param.comment: Trade cache pool: mk3 (traders) or mk4 (supply)

param.name: cacheReadOffset
param.comment: Rotates cache scan start so concurrent fleet ships pick different entries first

param.name: sellPriceMax
param.comment: Max vs ware average for supplier sell offers (ship buys). Normalized -1..+1 offset; 1.0 = no filter (isolated). Matches live search SellPriceMax.

param.name: buyPriceMin
param.comment: Min vs ware average for customer buy offers (ship sells). Normalized -1..+1 offset; -1.0 = no filter (isolated). Matches live search BuyPriceMin.

param.name: bypassPlayerSellerPricing
param.comment: When true, skip supplier price-band purge for player-owned suppliers (MK3 Ignore Player Pricing).

param.name: enableMinCargoUtil
param.comment: Per-ship cache selection: skip rows below ship capacity x minCargoUtilPercent. Fleet-min applies only at cache-refresh live search.

param.name: maxRouteTrades
param.comment: When gt 1, min-cargo util is enforced at multitrade route assembly, not per cache row.

param.name: mk4Priorities
param.comment: Class sliders table (MK4 supply). Class-at-0 filter runs only when cachePool=mk4.

param.name: minstorage
param.comment: MK4: only supply Stations when fill % is below this. 100 = disabled.

param.name: ignoreTradeRules
param.comment: When false, drop entries where a player-owned station's trade rules block the pair (NPC×NPC ignores cantradewith).

param.name: distancePenalty
param.comment: MK3 ship-route score (matches lib.gt.tradematch Tater scale; order UI/50).

param.name: blacklistGroup
param.comment: Blacklist-aware ship→buy and buy→sell for lib.gt.cache.score_for_ship.

param.name: skipReadTimePurge
param.comment: When true, skip universal TTL/dead-ref purge (post-refresh right after cache.write already cleaned the pool).

param.name: fleetKey
param.comment: MK4 fleet bucket key (e.g. $MK4F_...). Required when cachePool=mk4.
